narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The nightly store export pipeline has stopped delivering scan lines for the northern stores. It used to push those records to the warehouse before the forecast job kicked off, but the process now stalls partway through the transfer. Because the automated feed is down, the team manually pulls the raw till data from the source system each morning and loads it into the staging area by hand. This workaround keeps the models running on stale numbers for that region, but it is the only way we are getting the data into the pipeline right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational status of the pipeline failure and the manual workaround being used, without expressing a wish, refusal, or explicit trade-off decision.
